**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity), NONCOMPETE.**

- **Responsive clause:** the second Section 12.4 (p0046) — a term-plus-24-month, any-territory, undefined-scope non-compete binding Customer. This is walk-away territory and fails all five fallback elements (no named product, post-term reach, 24 months, no internal-development or acquisition carve-outs).
- **Conflict noted:** Section 12.3 (p0044) expressly states Customer has given no non-compete commitment, so 12.4 was internally contradictory.
- **Not flagged here:** the first Section 12.4 (p0045) no-hire restriction (separate rule) and Section 24.2's competitor-assignment limit on Vendor (benefits us).
- **Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** surgical replace of the prohibitory operator and duration — "During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire" → "Customer may develop, market, sell, or acquire" — leaving the remaining words verbatim and aligning 12.4 with 12.3.
